main_body: A three-tier votive stand: three thin gray shelf slats (each a 1-row light edge plus a 1-row dark underside) holding rows of small candles, with a dark base slab below. The legs and sides are barely drawn.
top_band: none. Each shelf is a 1-row light gray line (L=170) above a 1-row dark line (L=61), which is a rim/edge only and not a surface
evidence: The column scan shows each shelf as one light row (L=170) and one dark row (L=61). That is only a 1px edge, not a foreshortened top surface several rows tall. The candles stand on these lines with no visible tabletop and no front face below them. The whole piece reads as a flat front-view diagram of shelves, so it is a front elevation with only a rim. The 3/4 contract is not met.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 11 distinct colours against 38-40 in the references. The piece is smaller than one tile, so there is no per-tile median. The shelves are only about 3 tones (light gray, dark gray, near-black base). The candles are simple 2-3 colour dabs with no grain or texture. Only 9% of the dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outline is tinted bluish-gray and not a sticker line. The piece is far thinner and flatter than the Beodeul references, which carry tiles, grain and multi-step ramps.
